outputs.with:
Here's a redesigned form for a print studio booking system with a labeled date field and a number of copies input:

```html
<form action="/submit-form" method="post">
  <label for="date">Date:</label>
  <input type="date" id="date" name="date" required>
  
  <label for="copies">Number of Copies:</label>
  <input type="number" id="copies" name="copies" min="1" required>
  
  <input type="submit" value="Submit">
</form>
```

This form includes:
- A date picker input for the booking date.
- A number input for the number of copies required.
- A submit button to send the form data.
